answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops fakes. To claim one work slot, an agent burns a 25 POA deposit, never refunded; one slot, one identity. A willow bends but never multiplies: one deposit, one slot, no forest. Forging 1,000 identities burns 25,000 POA; slots pay only for real work. Honest agents pay once and earn fees and a share of burned deposits. The signal is clear at the zenith: burning proves the owner values the slot more than the attack.
